report.summary: Audited spectral.py. Two high-severity bugs: graph_from_edges and graph_from_reach lack HAVE_MATH guard, causing NameError when networkx not installed. fiedler_report's algebraic_connectivity call is unguarded, can crash and violates docstring guarantee that no measurement raises. eigengap_report appears truncated in provided context, risk of incomplete function. No concurrency issues detected.
risks: graph_from_edges and graph_from_reach will raise NameError if networkx not installed (HAVE_MATH=False). Trigger: import without networkx and call graph_from_edges({}).

fiedler_report can raise uncaught exception from nx.algebraic_connectivity on eigensolver failure, contrary to docstring's 'nothing blocks or crashes'. Trigger: graph where fiedler_vector succeeds but algebraic connectivity fails (convergence).
eigengap_report snippet cuts off after 'confiden', possibly incomplete, risking SyntaxError or missing logic. Not fully visible in audit slice.
todos: Add `if not HAVE_MATH: return _unavailable(MATH_EXTRA_HINT)` at start of graph_from_edges and graph_from_reach.
Wrap nx.algebraic_connectivity call in fiedler_report in try/except, returning _unavailable on failure.
Verify eigengap_report function is complete in actual source; if not, complete it.

handoff.suggestion: Implement fixes for missing HAVE_MATH guards and fiedler_report's algebraic_connectivity exception handling. Check completeness of eigengap_report.
